landing.headline: Mastering, explained to producers.
landing.subheadline: Analyze your track against a commercial reference. Get concrete suggestions for your DAW. Learn to master on your own, one track at a time.
landing.mission_body: We believe quality mastering shouldn't be reserved for those with a professional studio. Millions of home producers make excellent music that can't compete sonically because it's missing a well-executed mastering pass. We want to close that gap with knowledge, not magic.
landing.audience_body: Home producers who want to finish their tracks with a competitive master, without having to learn a craft from scratch.
landing.how_body: You upload your track and a commercial reference. The app measures loudness, spectrum and stereo image. Then it tells you exactly what to fix, and which native DAW plugins to use.
landing.no_auto_body: No magic algorithm. No 'upload and download the finished master'. Automatic tools hand you a file — we give you the understanding to get there yourself. If you want a button that does it all, this project isn't for you. If you want to learn how, welcome.
landing.step1: Upload your unmastered track and a commercial reference from the same genre.
landing.step2: The app analyzes loudness, spectrum and stereo image, and compares them with the reference.
landing.step3: You get concrete advice: which plugin, which parameter, by how much — specific to your DAW.
landing.step4: Apply, re-upload, repeat. With practice, the suggestions become unnecessary: your ears are enough.
landing.purpose_body: Every suggestion explains the why: what you're correcting, by how much, and what effect it will have. You don't memorize 'if you have X dB, cut Y Hz' — you learn to recognize what sounds off and what to do about it. It's a journey. With enough practice, the suggestions become unnecessary: your ears are enough.
landing.open_body: The code is open. You can read it, fork it, improve it. If you can code, send a pull request. If you can master, share your use cases. If you're still learning, report what's broken. Every contribution makes the tool better for everyone.
landing.footer: Made for home producers · Open source · {{year}}

guide.title: How to proceed
guide.step1: Apply the suggestions in priority order (P1 → P5).
guide.step2: After each change, re-upload the track to check the delta.
guide.step3: Repeat until the suggestions drop to zero.
